data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'fron', meaning 'front' or 'above'. Fridell is a name that conveys a sense of peace and friendliness. In ancient Greece, this name was given to children born into noble families, symbolizing their high social status and the desire for peace and harmony in their communities. The name Fridell carries the meaning “Peaceful, Friendly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fridell usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, friendly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
